verdict.rationale: Credential handling is a fair question for an LLM chat platform that manages provider API keys, so the axis applies. The pack documents no secrets store, no environment-variable separation for keys, and no redaction of credentials from chat history. Self-hosting, SSO, and local-storage privacy statements are adjacent and do not show deliberate secret handling.

support.subject: As a security engineer, credentials are handled deliberately — a secrets store or env separation with redaction, never API keys pasted into chat history
